summary: Added three ECS rules: E3052 FargateNetworkMode (Fargate task definitions need NetworkMode awsvpc), E3053 FargateServiceNetworkConfiguration (FARGATE services need NetworkConfiguration), and E3054 FargateContainerPrivileged (Fargate tasks can't set Privileged true). Each has a schema extension, a rule class, and unit tests. docs/rules.md has three new rows and the count is now 228. ECS unit tests pass (66). Full unit suite: 1524 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph, needs pygraphviz/pydot, not installed in the venv). test_formatters.py was skipped (defusedxml missing). Tests were run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo src because the venv's cfnlint points at another checkout. Nothing committed. The rule choice was my own reading of the vague spec; I could not check issue #1547.
